QLabel.name: eeprom_warning
QLabel.text: Advanced only: this flashes the physical monitor memory—permanent until written again. Unlike the Windows Override tab (reversible registry patch only), EEPROM cannot be undone by deleting registry keys. Hardware access depends on OS and GPU/backend (Windows: AMD ADL / NVIDIA NVAPI; Linux may use ddcutil for reads).

QLabel.name: login_text
QLabel.text: Sign in with an approved project-tracker account to unlock permanent EEPROM read/write operations.
